RE3_codec v0.13 recovered Binary01 report
==========================================
Retail corpus used in the original v0.13 session: 100 EMD (69 primary + 31 EMD08).
Non-dummy Binary01 sections: 12; 8 unique primary EMDs.

Validated grammar:
  u32 part_mask
  u32 records_end
  u32 rest_pos_size
  for set bits in ascending part index:
    u32 vertex_data_offset
    u32 frame_stride
    u32 extra_frame_count
    u32 reserved[extra_frame_count]
  rest positions, then morph vertex frames

Observed invariants:
- part-mask bit matches MD2 object index
- frame_stride == align4(part.vertex_count * 6)
- frame_count == extra_frame_count + 1
- record chain ends exactly at records_end
- rest pose matches Normal EMR local positions
- recovered corpus reserved words were zero
